citations.quote: We do not pay for mechanical or electrical breakdown, failure or wear and tear, unless it results from an incident covered under MOTOR-COV-2.1 or MOTOR-COV-2.5.

coverage.reasoning: The claimant experienced a sudden engine stop due to an internal failure while driving, which constitutes a mechanical breakdown without any prior accident. According to exclusion MOTOR-EXC-4.4, mechanical or electrical breakdown or failure is not covered unless it results from an incident covered under MOTOR-COV-2.1 or MOTOR-COV-2.5. Since no such covered incident occurred, the claim is excluded from coverage.
